{{Quote|Thirsty?''"<br />"''Always. You have a table?''"<br />"''Right over there. Bink's already ordered your favorite cognac.''"<br />''"Great. Lead the way.|[[Tavia Kitik]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]|<ref name="Winner Lose All">''[[Winner Lose All]]''</ref>}}
'''Cognac''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage. It was classified as a type of [[Liquor/Legends|liquor]].<ref name="X-Wing: Rogue Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref> It was a notoriously unpredictable drink, with the taste and quality varying widely between [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] and often even across different regions of the same [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="Scoundrels">''[[Scoundrels]]''</ref> [[Abrax/Legends|Abrax]] was a type of cognac.
